svg.aria-label: Left: activation standard deviations for 1,024 input vectors of width 64 through ten random ReLU layers, on a logarithmic axis. Right: one 2×3 matrix processed by BatchNorm and LayerNorm, with numerical values shown. Learned affine terms are disabled and current-input statistics are used; input and normalized values have separate color scales.
